parts.title: A New Day
parts.text: Zoe came into class with a big smile. The teacher gave her a warm **welcome**. Mateo said in a **whisper**, “May I **borrow** your red pencil?” Zoe handed it over. “Thank you,” he said. He was always **polite**.

parts.title: Play Time
parts.text: Today the class would put on a play. Anika wanted to **pretend** to be a queen. Her crown began to **sparkle** in the light. Zoe set out a **neat** row of chairs. Mateo started to **giggle** when Anika bowed.

parts.title: The Show
parts.text: Then the play began. Anika stood up straight and felt **proud**. When she finished, the class began to **clap**. Zoe and Mateo gave a loud **cheer**. Anika began to **wonder** if she could be the queen again.

parts.title: A Happy Day
parts.text: The play was over. The friends hugged and smiled. It had been a happy day at school.

To hit your hands together to make a sound. Example: We clap when the song ends.

definitions.meaning1: To shine with little flashes of light. Example: Snow seems to sparkle in the sun.
